expansion_contract.fact_row: verified official-source, canonical-state, workflow-evidence or acceptance-contract fact
expansion_contract.boundary_row: prevents historical premise counts, business matches, active-line speeds, usage aggregates or modelled FWA from being promoted to exact January 2026 postcode or parcel coverage without accepted r2 bytes and hardened postjoin evidence

source_routes.name: Methodology Annex business, speed and FWA screenshots

facts.detail: The terminal heartbeat has no active owner lease.
No active or over-15-minute PENDING execution exists.

guard_streams.write_limit: No second task, owner takeover or parallel runner is permitted.

facts.detail: The exact 11,013-row output JSONL remains empty.
The source snapshot remains exact_rows_returned zero and source_scan_complete remains false.

guard_streams.write_limit: No candidate or 3/4 promotion before exact r2 and hardened postjoin acceptance.

facts.detail: The July 2025 fixed-coverage premise base contains 32.4 million premises.
30.3 million are residential and the base derives from AddressBase Premium and Islands Epoch 119.

guard_streams.write_limit: Historical premise-base totals cannot be assigned to January 2026 postcode rows.

facts.detail: AddressBase was enriched with the ONS 2021 Census National Statistics Postcode Lookup from May 2025.
Urban and rural categories were derived from the Locale classification.

guard_streams.write_limit: Geographic enrichment classifications are not coverage observations.

facts.detail: Ofcom defines superfast availability using a 30 Mbit/s download threshold.
Gigabit-capable networks are defined as capable of delivering 1 Gbit/s download.

guard_streams.write_limit: Threshold definitions cannot create an exact parcel speed.

facts.detail: Decent broadband is defined as at least 10 Mbit/s download and 1 Mbit/s upload.
The decent-broadband reporting population also includes premises not matched to any provider record.

guard_streams.write_limit: An unmatched premise is not automatically a zero-speed parcel.

facts.detail: The Dun and Bradstreet Business Universe supplied more than 3.9 million business-location records.
Nearly 3.3 million business records, 84 percent, were linked to AddressBase UPRNs using building or street and postcode identification.

guard_streams.write_limit: Third-party business records cannot replace exact Ofcom postcode coverage.

facts.detail: A further 550,000 business records, 14 percent, could only be matched to postcodes.
Just under 100,000 business records, 2.5 percent, could not be matched.

guard_streams.write_limit: Postcode-only or unmatched business records are not exact parcel identities.

facts.detail: After removing ambiguous matches, the business analysis was constrained to 2.5 million records within the Connected Nations premise base.
The broadband-product coverage collection excludes dedicated leased-line connectivity available to many businesses.

guard_streams.write_limit: Business-product coverage is not a complete measure of enterprise connectivity.

facts.detail: The July 2025 active-line collection covered 57 fixed network and internet service providers.
Per-connection submissions covered retail services and wholesale services supplied to other ISPs.

guard_streams.write_limit: Active connections measure take-up and performance, not current availability.

facts.detail: Take-up was estimated using active lines against July 2025 coverage data for temporal consistency.
Ofcom identified when full fibre was first reported available to each covered property for the take-up analysis.

guard_streams.write_limit: Historical availability timing cannot be inferred for the current parcel rows.

facts.detail: Providers supplied maximum line speeds and, for non-full-fibre technologies, average upload and download speeds.
Speeds could be measured or configured values when measurements were unavailable.

guard_streams.write_limit: Configured active-line speed is not a measured parcel value.

facts.detail: Only 18 million of approximately 26.5 million reported lines had postcode geography and speed greater than zero for analysis.
Average-speed calculations weighted eligible records to the actual reported number of active lines.

guard_streams.write_limit: Weighted aggregate performance cannot be downscaled to a postcode or parcel.

facts.detail: Monthly usage was derived from upload and download traffic aggregated at OLTs or headends and their connected-line counts.
FWA may use MNO capacity shared with mobile users or dedicated WISP networks; coverage used provider modelling as of July 2025.

guard_streams.write_limit: Usage aggregates and modelled FWA are not exact fixed-line postcode metrics.

guard_streams.source: CN2025 Methodology Annex, provider screenshot and canonical workflow evidence

facts.detail: MNOs and WISPs listed properties serviceable without new access points and identified whether service met the decent-broadband threshold; both used the same premise base as fixed coverage.
The annex lists 16 WISPs and three FWA MNOs and removes stale WISP entries without new data or unchanged-data confirmation; current workflow checks returned zero PR-triggered runs and no promotions.

guard_streams.write_limit: Provider rosters and modelled eligibility cannot substitute for exact all-premises r2 postcode acceptance.
